description: Defines a wait-free multi-producer single-consumer (MPSC) queue implementation for Zephyr RTOS, including data structures, atomic operations, and queue management functions.

methods.name: rtio_mpsc_init
methods.description: Initializes or resets an MPSC queue.

methods.name: rtio_mpsc_push
methods.description: Pushes a node into the MPSC queue in a wait-free manner.

methods.name: rtio_mpsc_pop
methods.description: Pops a node from the MPSC queue, returning NULL if empty.
